## Definition of Done (Section 16)

- [ ] States designed: loading · empty · error · denied · offline
- [ ] Light **and** dark verified at 360 / 768 / 1280
- [ ] Keyboard + screen-reader pass; axe clean on touched screens
- [ ] i18n: en + ne (no hard-coded strings), BS/AD dates through `packages/i18n`
- [ ] Permissions / entitlement guards respected
- [ ] Machine tested (if this is a workflow) · MSW handlers + fixtures added
- [ ] Storybook story per state · README / screen inventory updated
- [ ] AI-tell checklist (Section 9.10) passed
- [ ] Bundle within budget (initial JS ≤ 200 KB gz)
